##### Project general facts

Damac Casa is a luxury residential development by Damac Properties located in Dubai Media City, offering an exclusive urban lifestyle with panoramic views of Palm Jumeirah. The project is positioned in one of Dubai’s key media and business districts, combining a prime central location with scenic waterfront and skyline vistas. Designed with a focus on refined city living, it provides residents with immediate access to major business hubs, entertainment venues, and coastal attractions, creating a balanced environment of convenience and prestige.
 
The development offers a curated selection of amenities designed to enhance comfort and modern urban living, supported by a sophisticated residential environment. Its location in Dubai Media City ensures strong connectivity to key districts while maintaining a sense of privacy and exclusivity. Residents benefit from proximity to leisure destinations, waterfront areas, and cultural landmarks, making it a well-rounded lifestyle destination in the heart of the city.

The interiors are finished with porcelain tile flooring, painted walls, and feature walls in selected areas across living rooms and bedrooms, with wardrobes provided in all bedrooms. Kitchens are fitted with cabinets, stone countertops, backsplash, stainless steel sinks, and porcelain tile flooring, while bathrooms feature porcelain cladding, mosaic feature walls in master bathrooms, stone-topped vanities, and full sanitary fittings with mirrors. The kitchens are equipped with appliances including cooker, hood, refrigerator, and washing machine, and the residences are delivered unfurnished, offering a clean and modern finish with durable materials and functional design.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Media City is a well-established business and residential hub in Dubai, originally developed as a free zone dedicated to media, advertising, and communications companies. Over time, it has evolved into a mixed-use district that combines corporate headquarters, residential towers, hotels, and leisure facilities. Its urban layout is modern and well-structured, with a strong focus on connectivity and professional infrastructure, making it one of the key knowledge and creative economy zones in the city.

One of the main advantages of Dubai Media City is its exceptional location and accessibility. It sits along Sheikh Zayed Road, providing direct routes to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah within minutes. The area is also well connected via public transport, including the Dubai Metro and tram systems in nearby districts. This central positioning makes it highly attractive for professionals, entrepreneurs, and residents who value short commuting times and easy access to both business and leisure destinations.

In terms of lifestyle, Dubai Media City benefits from its proximity to some of Dubai’s most popular waterfront and entertainment areas, including Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach Residence. The district offers a calm, professional atmosphere during the day while being close to vibrant dining, beach clubs, and nightlife options just a short drive away. This combination of business efficiency and lifestyle convenience makes it a highly desirable location for those seeking a balanced urban environment in the heart of New Dubai.
